essence: The desired result comes by the stated means rather than ritual worship.
Meditation is performed seated, after saluting the guru.
The supreme seed syllable is combined with sixteen vowels.
The form arises from the true moon disk and is bathed in nectar.
All misfortune dissolves while auspicious śrī nourishment is caused.
